title: Gear
subtitle: A hub with teeth
description: A large solid hub with eight teeth -- six on the smallest nodes, or the teeth merge -- cut as wide-rooted trapezoids: wider where they meet the hub than at their tips, which is what makes the silhouette read as cut rather than grown.

The hub reaches just over two thirds of the way across, so a centred item has material under it and an edge to be seen against. A row through a tooth is wider than the gap row nearer the middle, so the icon's fit asks every row rather than only the ends of a candidate square.
